text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, it starts raining while I'm out, so I decide to go shopping to pass the time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, just as the rain starts letting up…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh! Sup, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer runs up to me from out of nowhere, dressed in her signature racewear and drenched from head to toe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you talking about my clothes? Don't worry! They'll dry while I run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oops, I suppose that's not much of an explanation, is it? Well, you see…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer gives me a smile that's closer to a grimace and brings me up to speed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: …So anyway, I got invited to one of the Mejiro family's stuffy old parties.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Then someone was like, "A car has been prepared for your return, miss," and whatever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And, I dunno. I just couldn't stand it anymore, so I yelled out a quick apology and hightailed it out of there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That sounds so much like her, I can't help but smile, but I'm still worried about her clothes, which look soaked all the way through.
choice_data_list: Are you sure it's okay to leave your racewear dripping wet like that?
Are you sure it's okay to leave your racewear dripping wet like that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Welp. Guess it's only natural that you're worried about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But it's fine, really. I had my outfit made like this for this very purpose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Like, my signature racewear doesn't look all that different from my regular clothes, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's why I don't really have to fuss over it that much. It's easy to run in and easy to take the lead in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The best part is, I can just sprint off whenever I get the urge to run alone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It feels odd to hear her talking about wanting to be alone since she's almost always part of a group, so I ask her about her wording.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah. I love hanging out with everyone, of course, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: When I'm at the front of a race, I'm alone, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I guess that why I sometimes get the urge to get out there and run without thinking about anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I just want to head for the horizon, alone and free as a bird, and go as far as I want!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her gaze is set to some distant point, out beyond all the restrictions and restraints. Some place free…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We stand there silently for a few moments until we're abruptly interrupted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Agh! It's coming down again!
choice_data_list: How about we hit a cafe till the rain passes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We should be able to escape the worst of it if we run back! Let's go—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I open an umbrella and hold it over our heads. I hope she doesn't feel too embarrassed to share it with me, but I only have the one.
choice_data_list: I can't let you catch a cold.
I can't let you catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa… Talk about being a rizzler, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Now I wanna do that for someone. Just open up an umbrella all cool-like and go, "I can't let you catch a cold."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I dunno if I can pull it off as well as you did, though! That was just way too smooth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oooh! I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Here's your hot coffee.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her being in her signature racewear, Mejiro Palmer looks completely in her element inside the cafe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm? Whatcha starin' at me for?
choice_data_list: Just thinking how well that racewear suits you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wha? Huh? What's with the sudden compliment?!
choice_data_list: Oh, nothing. It just kind of dawned on me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uuugh! Look, our coffees are gonna get cold if you keep talking nonsense! Down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer and I relax and share some laughs after that.
